header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Rao Faisal Ali advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon A.A.G alongwith Asad Ali Assistant
body: Accounts Officer, Accounts Office, Mirpurkhas & Najeeb Ahmed Shah XEN Drainage Mirpurkhas Division.

Learned A.A.G files statements of the respondents, taken on record. The XEN Drainage Mirpurkhas Division submits that case of the petitioner is re-submitted and his grievance will be redressed within a shortest time. In view of the above, the instant petition stands disposed of with direction to the respondents to redress the grievance of the petitioner within a period of thirty (30) thirty days.
